affordance_in_statement: "JOB i ... The constraints restricted only to signal i across both stages ... are already contradictory" and "LOAD c ... The constraints restricted only to stage c across all signals ... are already contradictory," together with the duration, sequential, exclusivity, non-negative activation, and global-deadline rules.
removal_suggestion: This cannot be removed by rewording alone: the isolated-job and isolated-stage systems intrinsically reduce to p1 + p2 > T and sum(stage durations) > T. It would require changing the certificate semantics to include a genuinely non-additive cross-signal or cross-stage condition.

common_affordance: The certificate definitions are separable: an isolated job is contradictory exactly when p1 + p2 > T, while an isolated stage is contradictory exactly when the sum of its processing times exceeds T.
recommended_edit: Change the certificate predicate—not the output tokens—so JOB and LOAD validity requires a non-additive witness involving cross-signal or cross-stage interactions, rather than only an isolated path length or total stage load.
